items.title: Public launch
items.text: Open the repository, this website, and a Docker quickstart checked on a clean machine.

items.title: Source citations in every episode
items.text: Each line points to the source it came from, shown in the transcript.

items.title: Audio and podcast sources
items.text: Drop in an MP3 or a podcast episode; it is transcribed locally and discussed like any other source.

items.title: Saved source trays
items.text: Save a mix of feeds and notes as a template that a watchlist refills on a schedule.

items.title: Longer, smoother episodes
items.text: Closer to NotebookLM in length and flow, measured in the blind test.

items.title: Vozonda Cloud
items.text: Hosted, pay per episode with Lightning, if enough people ask for it.

items.title: Hosts with a stance
items.text: Give each host a position on a topic for real debates.

items.title: Nostr bookmarks as a source
items.text: Bookmark an article in your Nostr app and it becomes an episode, read from your public bookmark list (NIP-51).
